source: NCERT Class XII, Introductory Microeconomics, Ch. 3 (Production and Costs).

sections.heading: 1. Production Function
points: **Production function** = the relationship between **inputs (factors)** and **output**.
**Short run** — at least one factor is fixed (variable factors adjust); **Long run** — all factors are variable.
**Total Product (TP), Average Product (AP = TP/units), and Marginal Product (MP = ΔTP/Δinput)**.

sections.heading: 2. Law of Variable Proportions
points: The **Law of Variable Proportions (short run)** — as more of a variable factor is added to fixed factors, the **MP first rises, then falls, and may become negative** (three stages).
This is due to **increasing returns → diminishing returns → negative returns** to the variable factor.
**Returns to scale (long run):** increasing, constant, or decreasing returns as all inputs change proportionately.

sections.heading: 3. Costs of Production
points: **Fixed costs (TFC)** — do not vary with output (rent, machinery); **Variable costs (TVC)** — vary with output (raw materials, wages).
**Total Cost (TC) = TFC + TVC**.
**Average Cost (AC) = TC/output; Average Fixed Cost (AFC); Average Variable Cost (AVC); Marginal Cost (MC) = ΔTC/Δoutput**.
AFC falls continuously; AC and AVC are **U-shaped**; **MC cuts AC and AVC at their minimum**.

sections.heading: 4. Cost Curves — Short and Long Run
points: In the **short run**, AC/AVC/MC are U-shaped (due to the law of variable proportions).
In the **long run**, the LAC (long-run average cost) is also U-shaped (due to returns to scale — economies then diseconomies of scale).
The gap between AC and AVC (= AFC) narrows as output rises.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Short run = one factor fixed; long run = all variable.
Law of Variable Proportions: MP rises, then falls (diminishing returns).
TC = TFC + TVC; AC = TC/output; MC = ΔTC/Δoutput.
AC and AVC are U-shaped; MC cuts them at their minimum.
Returns to scale (long run): increasing, constant, decreasing.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Law of Variable Proportions is a short-run law** (one factor fixed); **returns to scale is long-run**.
**MC intersects AC and AVC at their minimum points**.
**AFC falls continuously** (never U-shaped); AC/AVC are U-shaped.
**TC = TFC + TVC**; fixed costs don't vary with output.
